target.class_name: Anh văn chuyên ngành Cơ khí
target.lesson_title: Chapter 4: Measurements — Đo lường: hệ đo, dụng cụ đo và dung sai

exam.title: Kiểm tra từ vựng Chapter 4: Measurements

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
An imperial unit of liquid volume.
questions.explanation: quart = quart (đơn vị thể tích imperial, gần 1 lít).

questions.question: Which English word means “thước cặp”?
questions.explanation: vernier caliper: A tool with a sliding jaw for measuring the size of an item.

questions.question: Which English word means “panme đo trong”?
questions.explanation: inside micrometer: A micrometer that measures the inner width of a hole.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A metric measure of length or distance.
questions.explanation: centimeter = xentimét.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A tool that measures small distances.
questions.explanation: micrometer = panme (dụng cụ đo khoảng cách rất nhỏ).

questions.question: What does feeler gauge mean?
options: thước đa năng (đầu vuông kèm thước lá)
questions.explanation: feeler gauge = thước lá đo khe hở.

questions.question: What does tape measure mean?
questions.explanation: tape measure = thước cuộn.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
The system based on the meter.
questions.explanation: metric = hệ mét (mét, lít, kilôgam).

questions.question: Which English word means “đơn vị thể tích nhỏ của hệ Anh”?
questions.explanation: cubic inch: An imperial measure of volume.

questions.question: Which English word means “làm hỏng, làm mòn tròn (bu lông, vít)”?
questions.explanation: round off: To damage a screw or bolt.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A difference from a precise size.
questions.explanation: deviation = độ lệch, sai lệch.

questions.question: Which English word means “được phép, chấp nhận được”?
questions.explanation: permissible: Allowed.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A micrometer that measures how deep a hole is.
questions.explanation: depth micrometer = panme đo sâu.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
Exactly correct.
questions.explanation: accurate = chính xác (đúng 100%).

questions.question: Which English word means “lít”?
questions.explanation: liter: A metric measure of volume.

questions.question: What does dimension mean?
options: nhịp, sải (khoảng giữa hai đầu mút)
kích thước (dài, rộng, cao, đường kính…)
questions.explanation: dimension = kích thước (dài, rộng, cao, đường kính…).

questions.question: Which English word means “sự khác nhau về kích thước”?
questions.explanation: variation: A difference between parts made from the same design.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
Changing from one system into another.
questions.explanation: conversion = sự đổi (từ hệ đo này sang hệ đo khác).

questions.question: Which English word means “dung sai”?
questions.explanation: tolerance: A range of acceptable size.

questions.question: Which English word means “cân Anh (khoảng 0,45 kg)”?
questions.explanation: pound: An imperial measure of weight.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A micrometer that measures the outer width of a part.
questions.explanation: outside micrometer = panme đo ngoài (khung chữ C).

questions.question: Which English word means “hệ đo lường Anh–Mỹ”?
questions.explanation: imperial: The system that uses inches and quarts.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A metric measure of weight.
questions.explanation: kilogram = kilôgam.

questions.question: What does precise mean?
options: chính xác, tinh (đúng đến từng chi tiết nhỏ)
questions.explanation: precise = chính xác, tinh (đúng đến từng chi tiết nhỏ).

questions.question: What does within mean?
options: khe hở lắp ghép giữa hai chi tiết
chính xác, tinh (đúng đến từng chi tiết nhỏ)
questions.explanation: within = trong phạm vi, trong khoảng.
